Delete evaluative words such as 'fake', 'invents', 'pretends', 'actually', 'really', 'turned out', 'found out', 'realized', 'it was a lie'. When in doubt, REMOVE. The result must NOT let a reader infer the point of the story.
Do not summarize, paraphrase, infer, or add anything; only keep-or-blank the original words.
